name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the murder of Mehdi Kessaci: urgent need for ambitious European action against drug trafficking
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the murder of Mehdi Kessaci, a 20-year-old from Marseille killed in a case linked to drug gangs, and calls for tougher EU action against drug trafficking. It asks member states to treat drug gang membership as a crime, copy Italian anti-mafia asset seizure rules, boost police and intelligence cooperation, and tighten security at ports. It is a statement of political demands, not a law, so nothing changes yet.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states demands; EU laws and national rules stay as they are.
- **Who it affects:** Member states, police, ports, and people convicted of drug-related crimes.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council and Commission, which decide whether to act.
